intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

User delegates independently randomized complex concepts and reference-informed photographic generation and testing. Agent chooses an opening-era studio pocket-watch moment; these details are agent creative choices, not requester definitions.

Create a photographic three-quarter seated portrait of one adult woman, using the supplied portrait only for visible adult facial appearance and long dark wavy hair. She is checking a pocket watch immediately before the studio portrait exposure in an opening-era historical photographic atelier with a wooden bellows camera and painted backdrop. Her tailored Western formal clothing comprises a fitted charcoal wool frock coat with long divided tails, a high-collared ivory blouse, an ivory silk cravat, a fitted waistcoat, and a long dark skirt. The coat silhouette, collar construction, cravat knot, and restrained antique studio furnishings make the historical transitional fashion immediately visible. Seated sideways on a carved wooden chair, she holds an open gold pocket watch at upper waist height with its round dial facing the viewer; her gaze drops toward the dial while her other hand lightly touches the chain leading to a waistcoat pocket. The watch lid is visibly open, the chain has a continuous route, and both hands perform this single coherent action. A wooden bellows camera on its tripod stands behind her to the left, its dark focusing cloth hanging from the rear, while the painted architectural canvas fills the far wall. Late afternoon amber side light reveals fine wool texture and separates the ivory cravat from the collar; soft shadow preserves her recognizable facial proportions. Prioritize the clear watch-reading action, the full tailored coat structure and historical studio equipment together in the same frame, and the reference-visible facial appearance. Render realistic skin, believable fabric weight, warm subdued color and fine photographic grain.

obligation.composition_instruction: Choose one source medium or protocol and one failure mechanism native to it, confine that mechanism to a deliberate rupture zone, preserve recognizable content across the break, and repeat the same technological fingerprint at three or more separated intersections with the subject or background. Keep ordinary anatomy, object boundaries, text, and texture coherent outside that mechanism, and size the repeated evidence so the authored failure process remains inferable from the image without prompt text or a caption.

the mechanism remains inferable from the image alone

render_gates.description: The image visibly commits to one identifiable source medium or protocol rather than an unspecified digital mood.
Artifacts share one technically coherent failure family native to the selected medium or protocol.
A deliberate bounded rupture is compositionally legible instead of uniform decorative noise across the whole frame.
Enough subject and scene continuity survives across the break for the failed flow to remain perceptible.
The result is not carried by generic RGB separation, random static, scanlines, VHS texture, or unrelated effect stacking alone.

Without prompt text, a caption, or metadata, a viewer can infer the selected source-medium failure mechanism from the same fingerprint repeated at three or more separated image locations; merely noticing that the image looks broken fails.
Malformed anatomy, fused objects, broken text, muddy texture, or one isolated synthesis defect does not carry the intended medium-native glitch.
